title: MM-62006 Use display setting for invite chips
body:
#### Summary Fixed the channel invite multiselect so selected user chips use the same configured teammate display name as autocomplete results instead of always preferring nicknames. QA steps: 1. Set teammate name display to username. 2. Create a team user with username `chiptest` and nickname `Nick Chip`. 3. Open a channel where `chiptest` is not a member. 4. Open **Members > Add**, search for `chiptest`, and select the user. 5. Confirm the selected chip shows `chiptest`, matching the autocomplete result, not `Nick Chip`. #### Ticket Link Fixes: https://mattermost.atlassian.net/browse/MM-62006 #### Screenshots Before: ![before](https://cursor-plugin-pr-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/cursor/cursor/jira-bug-fix-agent-d0e8/mm-62006-before.png) After: ![after](https://cursor-plugin-pr-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/cursor/cursor/jira-bug-fix-agent-d0e8/mm-62006-after.png) #### Release Note ```release-note Fixed channel invite selected-user chips to respect the configured teammate display name. ```
  
## Change Impact: 🟢 Low **Regression Risk:** Changes are isolated to the channel invite modal display layer with an optional, backward-compatible property added to `MultiSelect` that includes a fallback to existing behavior. The `valueLabelRenderer` prop is optional and maintains the original `getDisplayName()` logic as a fallback, eliminating risk of breaking existing consumers of the `MultiSelect` component. **QA Recommendation:** Manual QA can be minimal beyond the documented QA steps. Focus on the specific invite flow with different `teammate_name_display_setting` configurations. Automated test coverage is new and comprehensive; spot-check other `MultiSelect` usages to ensure fallback behavior works as expected. [![Review Change Stack](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-stack-in-coderabbit-ui.svg)](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/mattermost/mattermost/pull/36520)
